CHAP. XXXV. 
 
  A prophecy against Edom for their hatred to Israel, ver. 1-13.   Their ruin shall be perpetual, ver. 14, 15.
V. 2. Mount Seir-The Edomites, who inhabited it.
V. 5. Their iniquity-When their iniquity was punished on them, which brought them to final ruin.
V. 6. And blood-Thy guilt, and my just revenge of innocent blood. Hast not hated-Thou hast loved, rather than hated, blood-shed; therefore vengeance for it follows thee.
V. 7. That passeth out-All travellers that go to or from Edom.
V. 10. Though-Though God was with Israel.
V. 14. The whole earth-The inhabitants of all the countries round about thee.  Rejoiceth-Is in peace and plenty.
